title: Filipino-Style Fried Rice
description: A twist on traditional fried rice, incorporating flavorful Filipino ingredients. Serve as a main dish or side.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add sliced sausage and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Remove sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and stir in the Filipino-Style Pepper Sauce.
Add cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice for about 5 minutes, until it starts to brown.
Add cooked pilaf to the skillet and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Return the cooked sausage to the skillet and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until everything is well combined.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds, if desired.
